description:
Refactor the single-module Maven project 'petclinic-mono' (located at ~/IdeaProjects/petclinic-mono) into a multi-module project. 

Goal: Create a parent POM and three child modules: 'petclinic-model', 'petclinic-service', and 'petclinic-app'.

Requirements:
1. 'petclinic-model': Move contents of 'com.petclinic.model' and 'com.petclinic.util' here.
2. 'petclinic-service': Move contents of 'com.petclinic.service' here. It should depend on 'petclinic-model'.
3. 'petclinic-app': Move 'com.petclinic.app' here. It should depend on 'petclinic-model' and 'petclinic-service'.
4. Parent POM: Must list the three modules.
5. Ensure the project compiles and packages successfully using 'mvn clean package'.
